answer: One defense is a rate-limited inlet with terraced escrow: only a fixed number of newcomers enter each epoch through a single inlet, and each posts an escrow deposit on a terrace that deepens with every identity sharing its funding trail. An independent auditor then stamps an ivory seal only after verifying distinct hardware and distinct funds; the seal expires each epoch unless fresh work renews it. A sybil farmer must fund a deepening deposit, pass a separate audit, and wait in the admission queue for every fake, while one honest agent enters once and keeps its seal alive by working.
